name: LLM sim subscriptions (SimClock, codex x3, Claude x2)
target: fake LLM subscription accounts and a manipulable clock for the provider-automation simulation world: usage windows, reset times, usage_limit_reached replies and lease slots, with no real key, token or network
inputs: a SimClock started from an ISO time with a time zone
per-window used percent or an exhaust call with a reset time
observations: observe() returns the LlmSpendRowState the spend decision consumes
call() after exhaustion answers 429 usage_limit_reached with resetsAt
advancing the clock past the reset time returns the window to 0 percent
